items.title: Ravencoin hits record low as network exploit puts transactions at risk
items.snippet: Mining pools controlling most of Ravencoin’s hash rate are building a competing chain that could trigger a three-day reorganization.
items.note: Негативний тон для загального ринку за ключовими словами -- варто звернути увагу.

items.title: SEC, CFTC sue Goliath Ventures over $400M crypto Ponzi scheme
items.snippet: Regulators allege Goliath promised crypto liquidity-pool returns but instead paid earlier investors and funded its founder’s luxury spending.
